required_visual_claims: The homepage clearly positions Dave for forward deployed engineering and adjacent customer-facing technical roles using source-grounded experience evidence.
Navigation and section wayfinding remain usable at desktop and phone widths across the primary route set.

The mobile update benchmark presents the matched 58.3-to-13.4-second runtime and 110-to-24 request comparison, retains 48 checks in both runs, and keeps the single-operation and no-engagement-savings caveat visible.
Client privacy, internal review and client release boundaries, source status, and the existing workstation illustration remain intact.
scope: Whole primary portfolio site: home, projects, experience, AI workflows, about, now, notes, and résumé; desktop routes with 390px phone captures for home and the AI workflow evidence journey
surface: davebettner.com local candidate compared with live production baseline
viewport: Candidate captures: desktop 1280x800 and phone 390x844; reviewer inspected desktop 1440x900 and phones 320x844 and 390x844

limits: Acceptance covers the local candidate, not deployment or employer verification.
The historical benchmark was not remeasured by the reviewer.
H15-H24 preservation was checked against the supplied base; their underlying outcomes were not re-audited.
The reviewer did not rerun the full build/browser suite; the implementation run had already completed npm test successfully.
visual_adjudication.summary: Independent whole-site review verified the local rendered candidate. The reviewer inspected /, /work/, /experience/, /ai-workflows/, /about/, /now/, /notes/, the connected-reporting case, and the résumé at desktop size; checked mobile navigation and workflow sections at 320x844 and 390x844; and visually inspected all seven candidate screenshots. Positioning matches the existing experience and résumé sources. Privacy and internal-review/client-release boundaries remain. The workstation illustration and assets remain intact. The benchmark and its matched-operation and no-engagement-savings caveats are readable on mobile. A nonblocking stale DESIGN.md navigation description was identified and then corrected by the implementation owner; this documentation-only edit does not change the rendered site.
